image_description: A side-profile view of a large American Bison standing on a dirt path. The bison has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump and a beard. The hindquarters are less furry and smoother. It has short curved horns, small ears hidden in fur, and sturdy legs. In the background, other bison are visible grazing in a green field.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile, showing a broad structure and short, upward-curving horns consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, shaggy beard hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the taxonomy description.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, consistent with the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and nestled within the thick fur of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic massive build and high withers typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, dark, shaggy fur, creating a very distinct and prominent shoulder hump.
There is a clear visual transition from the shaggy front to the smoother, shorter-haired hindquarters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are visibly short relative to the massive size of the head and body.
The legs appear sturdy and proportionate. While the hooves are partially obscured by grass/dirt, the visible lower leg structure is consistent with sturdy bovid limbs.
The tail is visible hanging down, ending in a distinct bushy tuft of hair.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out hybrid or generic bovid errors.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and the connection of the hump to the spine, ensuring no limb fusion or extra limbs.
To check for 'melting' artifacts where the shaggy fur meets the background, a common AI failure mode for complex textures.
To assess general texture consistency and look for subtle noise or blur patterns indicative of generation.

focus_areas: Fur texture consistency between forequarters and hindquarters
Boundary sharpness of the shaggy mane against the background
Leg joint anatomy and hoof definition
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the shaggy front fur and the smoother rear hide. AI often blurs this boundary unnaturally. Also, inspect the hooves for any sign of merging with the ground plane.
